transcript.en: Right, Sandra. You wanted to see me to get some feedback on your group's proposal.
transcript.zh: 好的，桑德拉。你想让我对你的小组提案提出一些反馈。

transcript.en: The one you're submitting for the Geography society field trip competition.
transcript.zh: 关于你提交的地理社会实地考察竞赛

transcript.en: Aha...
transcript.zh: 啊

transcript.en: I've had a look through your proposal and I think it's a really good choice.
transcript.zh: 我看了一遍你的提议，我觉得是一个很好的选择。

transcript.en: In fact, I only have a few things to say about it, but even in an outline document like this you really have to be careful to avoid typos and problems with layout in the proposal, and even in the contents page.
transcript.zh: 事实上，我只有几点要说，但是即使是像这样的大纲，你也要避免拼写错误，而且注意你在方案，甚至是在目录页的布局。

transcript.en: So read it through carefully before submitting it, okay?
transcript.zh: 所以在提交前仔细读一遍，好吗，

transcript.en: Will do.
transcript.zh: 好的

transcript.en: And I've made a few notes on the proposal about things which could have been better sequenced.
transcript.zh: 我在方案上就更好的排序问题做了标注

transcript.en: Okay.
transcript.zh: 好的

transcript.en: As for the writing itself, I've annotated the proposal as and where I thought it could be improved.
transcript.zh: 至于写作本身，当我觉得哪里需要改进的时候，我就做了注释。

transcript.en: Generally speaking, I feel you've often used complex structures and long sentences for the sake of it and as a consequence ...
transcript.zh: 总的来说，我觉得你常用复杂的长句子，

transcript.en: although your paragraphing and inclusion of sub-headings help ...
transcript.zh: 尽管你的分段和副标题可以起到帮助的作用

transcript.en: it's quite hard to follow your train of thought at times.
transcript.zh: 但是有时还是很难了解你的发展思路

transcript.en: So cut them down a bit, can you?
transcript.zh: 所以删去一些，好吗？

transcript.en: Really?
transcript.zh: 真的吗？

transcript.en: Yes. And don't forget simple formatting like numbering.
transcript.zh: 是的，别忘了一些简单的格式，比如编号。

transcript.en: Didn't I use page numbers?
transcript.zh: 我没有用页码吗？

transcript.en: I didn't mean that.
transcript.zh: 我不是说这个

transcript.en: Look, you've remembered to include headers and footers, which is good, but listing ideas clearly is important.
transcript.zh: 你记得使用页眉和页脚，这很好，但是清楚的列出观点很重要。

transcript.en: Number them or use bullet points, which is even clearer.
transcript.zh: 给它们编号或者使用更清楚的项目符号

transcript.en: Then you'll focus the reader on your main points.
transcript.zh: 然后你就能使读者关注你的要点

transcript.en: I thought your suggestion to go to the Navajo Tribal Park was a very good idea.
transcript.zh: 我认为你建议去纳瓦霍部落公园是一个很好的主意

transcript.en: I've always wanted to go there. My father was a great fan of cowboy films and the Wild West, so I was subjected to seeing all the epics, many of which were shot there.
transcript.zh: 我总想去那里。我父亲是西部牛仔电影的忠实爱好者，所以我也看了所有这类型的电影，许多电影还是在那里拍摄的。

transcript.en: As a consequence, it feels very familiar to me and it's awesome both geographically and visually, so it's somewhere I've always wanted to visit.
transcript.zh: 结果，我非常熟悉那里，无论是地理学上还是视觉上那里都非常美，所以我总是想去那里看看。

transcript.en: The subsequent research I did and the online photographs made me even keener.
transcript.zh: 我的后续研究和网上的照片使我对那里更加向往

transcript.en: Interesting.
transcript.zh: 有意思

transcript.en: Right, let's look at the content of your proposal now.
transcript.zh: 好的，现在让我们看看方案的目录，

transcript.en: Did you find it comprehensive enough?
transcript.zh: 你觉得它够全面吗？

transcript.en: Well, yes and no.
transcript.zh: 说不好

transcript.en: You've listed several different topics on your contents page, but I'm not sure they're all relevant.
transcript.zh: 你在目录页列举了一些不同的话题，但是我不确定它们都能切题，

transcript.en: No?
transcript.zh: 不能吗？

transcript.en: Well, I thought that from the perspective of a field trip, one thing I needed to focus on was the sandstone plateaux and cliffs themselves.
transcript.zh: 我认为从实地考察的角度，有一件事我需要关注的是砂岩高原和悬崖，

transcript.en: The way they tower up from the flat landscape is just amazing.
transcript.zh: 它们在平地中拔地而起的样子真是令人惊奇

transcript.en: The fact that the surrounding softer rocks were eroded by wind and rain, leaving these huge outcrops high above the plain.
transcript.zh: 周边的岩石受到风雨的侵蚀，露出了巨大的岩层，高高的处于平原之上。

transcript.en: It's hardly surprising that tourists flock to see the area.
transcript.zh: 怪不得成群的游客会到此参观

transcript.en: Well, yes, I'd agree with including those points…
transcript.zh: 是的。我同意这几点……

transcript.en: And then the fact that it's been home to native American Navajos and all the social history that goes with that.
transcript.zh: 事实上，这里曾是美国原住民纳瓦霍人的家园，所有社会历史都记录了这点。

transcript.en: The hardships they endured trying to save their territory from the invading settlers.
transcript.zh: 他们在抵抗侵略者以保卫领土的过程中遭受磨难

transcript.en: Their culture is so rich - all those wonderful stories.
transcript.zh: 他们的文化很丰富，都是神奇的故事。

transcript.en: Well, I agree it's interesting, but it's not immediately relevant to your proposal, Sandra, so at this stage, I suggest you focus on other considerations.
transcript.zh: 我也觉得这很有意思，但是这跟你的方案关系不大，桑德拉，所以在现阶段，我建议你关注其他方面。

transcript.en: I think an indication of what the students on the trip could actually do when they get there should be far more central, so that certainly needs to be included and to be expanded upon.
transcript.zh: 我认为告诉学生到那里后可以在行程中做些什么要更重要，这点肯定要加上去，并且展开描写。

transcript.en: And I'd like to see something about the local wildlife, and vegetation too, not that I imagine there's much to see.
transcript.zh: 我想看到一些关于当地野生动物和植被的描述，现在的描写不多。

transcript.en: Presumably the tourist invasion hasn't helped.
transcript.zh: 可能是因为游客的入侵帮了倒忙

transcript.en: Okay… I'II do some work on those two areas as well.
transcript.zh: 好的，我会在这两方面做工作。

transcript.en: But you're right, there's not much apart from some very shallow-rooted species.
transcript.zh: 但是你是对的，除了一些浅根的植物，那里基本没什么植被。

transcript.en: Although it's cold and snowy there in the winter, the earth is baked so hard in the summer sun that rainwater can't penetrate.
transcript.zh: 尽管那里的冬天又冷又多雪，但是夏季的阳光将地面烤得很硬，雨水无法渗透土壤。

transcript.en: So it's a case of flood or drought, really.
transcript.zh: 所以只有洪水和干旱。

transcript.en: So, I understand.
transcript.zh: 我明白

transcript.en: Now, before we look at everything in more detail, I've got a few factual questions for you.
transcript.zh: 现在，在我们看更多的细节之前，我有一些实际问题要问你，

transcript.en: It would be a good idea to include the answers in your finished proposal, because they're missing from your draft.
transcript.zh: 在你的方案成品上加上这些回答会是个好主意，因为现在你的草稿上并没有写，

transcript.en: Fine.
transcript.zh: 好的

transcript.en: So, you mentioned the monoliths and the spires, which was good, but what area does the tribal park cover?
transcript.zh: 你提到了独块巨石和尖塔，这点很好，但是部落公园覆盖面积是多少，

transcript.en: Do you know?
transcript.zh: 你知道吗？

transcript.en: 12,000 hectares, and the plain is at about 5,850 meters above sea level.
transcript.zh: 12，000公顷，平原超出海平面5850米。

transcript.en: Larger than I expected. Okay.
transcript.zh: 比我想的要大, 行。

transcript.en: Where's the nearest accommodation?
transcript.zh: 最近的住宿在哪儿？

transcript.en: That's a practical detail that you haven't included.
transcript.zh: 这个实际性细节你还没有提到

transcript.en: Have you done any research on that?
transcript.zh: 这方面你做调查了吗？

transcript.en: Yes. There's nowhere to stay in the park itself, but there's an old trading post called Goulding quite near.
transcript.zh: 是的。公园里面没有地方住，但是附近有一个叫做古尔丁的交易站，

transcript.en: All kinds of tours start from Goulding, too.
transcript.zh: 各种旅程也是从那里开始

transcript.en: What kind of tours?
transcript.zh: 什么样的旅程？

transcript.en: Well, the most popular are in four-wheel drive jeeps, but I wouldn't recommend hiring those.
transcript.zh: 最受欢迎的是乘坐四轮驱动的吉普车，但是我不推荐雇车。

transcript.en: I think the best way to appreciate the area would be to hire horses instead and trek around on those.
transcript.zh: 我认为最适合观赏这里的方式是骑马跋涉。

transcript.en: Biking is not allowed and it's impossible to drive around the area in private vehicles.
transcript.zh: 这里不允许骑自行车或开私家车

transcript.en: The tracks are too rough.
transcript.zh: 旅途很艰苦。

transcript.en: Okay, lastly, what else is worth visiting there?
transcript.zh: 好的，最后一点，那里还有什么是值得观看的？

transcript.en: There are several caves, but I haven't looked into any details.
transcript.zh: 那里还有一些山洞，但是我还没有调查它们的详细信息，

transcript.en: I'II find out about them.
transcript.zh: 我会查看一下。

transcript.en: Okay, good. Now what I'd like to know is…
transcript.zh: 好的，很好。现在我想知道……
